basic_details.job_title: CSIR NIO Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The CSIR National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR-NIO) has officially announced the Project Associate - II Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification has been published at https://www.nio.res.in/. Candidates holding an M.Sc. in Microbiology/Marine Microbiology with a minimum of two years of post-M.Sc. research experience can submit their online applications up to 02 August 2026. Candidates should refer to the official notification for age limit details. Direct links to download the official notification and apply online are shared below.

Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II position is 02 August 2026. Ensure you complete the application process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc degree in Microbiology or Marine Microbiology, along with a minimum of 2 years of research experience post their Master's degree.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - II position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate - II position at CSIR National Institute of Oceanography.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate - II position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 28,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. The job type is contractual, as indicated in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR National Institute of Oceanography located?
faq.answer: CSIR National Institute of Oceanography is located in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the Project Associate - II position?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of CSIR NIO or via the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is RCV/02/2026.
